notes:
Univale Transportes is an INTERMUNICIPAL bus operator in the Vale do Aco region (Ipatinga/Coronel Fabriciano/Timoteo/Ipaba/Santana do Paraiso), MG. There is NO metro/light-rail/BRT here; the only rail (Estacao Intendente Camara, EFVM) is a Vale cargo/regional stop used as a bus landmark, not a Univale line. So this is a bus-only (route_type=3) feed.

Route list (17 Univale lines) taken from onibus.online/mg/ipatinga. Two lines are fully documented from Moovit line PDFs (appassets.mvtdev.com) with ordered named stops AND published service windows:
 - 3183A Ipatinga/Ipaba (line 15): Ipatinga>Ipaba weekday 06:00-20:40, sat 06:15-22:05, sun 05:50-22:10, ~57min. Built both directions along the BR-458 corridor with representative stop chain (Camara/Terminal Rodoviario -> Castelo -> ETE Ipatinga -> Vale Verde/Distrito Industrial -> Porto Seguro -> Areal Naque -> Ipaba), ~40min headway.
 - 3182 Ipatinga/Timoteo (line 12): Timoteo>Ipatinga 05:20-18:10, Ipatinga>Timoteo 07:00-18:30, ~64min. Both directions along Av Acesita / Av Tancredo Neves (Timoteo -> Prefeitura -> Aperam -> Primavera -> Coronel Fabriciano -> Gontijo -> Unileste -> Estacao Intendente Camara -> Usimec -> DOAP -> HMC2 -> Terminal Rodoviario), ~45min headway.
The other 15 lines have a terminus-to-terminus representative trip per direction (endpoints geocoded; intermediate stops NOT modelled) at hourly weekday departures + weekend samples.

COORDINATES: WGS-84. Termini (Ipaba, Timoteo, Coronel Fabriciano, Santana do Paraiso, Iapu, Sao Joao do Oriente) and Estacao Intendente Camara from Wikipedia/Wikidata. Terminal Rodoviario, Camara Municipal, HMC2, Usimec, Shopping, DOAP anchored from address research. Intermediate BR-458/Av Acesita named stops interpolated along the corridor between geocoded anchors (approximate, marked in names). Nominatim/Overpass were blocked in this environment (429 / POST refused) so precise per-stop geocoding of the ~90 address-level Moovit stops was not possible; the 2 full lines use a curated representative subset of the PDF-evidenced named stops rather than every address point.

Confidence 0.45: route list and the 2 detailed lines' termini, corridors, service hours and stop landmarks are real and sourced; but intermediate coordinates are interpolated, exact per-address stops are collapsed to representative chains, headways are even-spaced approximations (real Moovit itineraries are irregular with 23 variants per line), and the 15 coarse routes are termini-only. Faithful skeleton, not stop-exact.

Files: /home/ubuntu/adresses/univale_gtfs/ (agency.txt, stops.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt, stop_times.txt, calendar.txt) + build.py. Validated: 0 referential-integrity errors, all stop_times monotonic, all stops referenced, sequences contiguous. 34 stops, 17 routes, 660 trips, 2200 stop_times.
